fault = true, target = "BloomEffect", property = "Enabled", toggle = true},

    local function shaderOpenCustomWindow()
        if ShaderCustomWindow and ShaderCustomWindow.Parent then
            ShaderCustomWindow.Visible = true
            if ShaderCustomBackdrop then ShaderCustomBackdrop.Visible = true end
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
            return
        end

        ShaderCustomControls = {}
        ShaderUISections = {}
        shaderDisconnectAll()

        ShaderCustomBackdrop = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Active = false,
            ZIndex = 300,
        })

        ShaderCustomWindow = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.52, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 380),
            Active = true,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.04,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 301,
        })
        ShaderCustomWindow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        corner(ShaderCustomWindow, 16)
        stroke(ShaderCustomWindow, Theme.Stroke, 1.5, 0.18)
        buildAnimatedBorder(ShaderCustomWindow, Theme.Accent, UDim.new(0, 16), true)
        mk("UISizeConstraint", {
            Parent = ShaderCustomWindow,
            MinSize = Vector2.new(360, 300),
            MaxSize = Vector2.new(520, 430),
        })

        local header = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = ShaderCustomWindow,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 72),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.22,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 302,
        })
        header:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        corner(header, 13)
        stroke(header, Theme.Stroke, 1.1, 0.58)

        local headerAccent = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = header,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 38),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, -19),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 303,
        })
        headerAccent:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(headerAccent, 99)

        local title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = header,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 24),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 10),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText("Personalizado", "Custom"),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 18,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 303,
        })
        title:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        title:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Personalizado")
        title:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Custom")

        local subtitle = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = header,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 16),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 35),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = GetText("Ajustes propios de Shaders · aplicación en tiempo real", "Shader-only controls · live application"),
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextSize = 10,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 303,
        })
        subtitle:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
        subtitle:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Ajustes propios de Shaders · aplicación en tiempo real")
        subtitle:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Shader-only controls · live application")

        local closeButton = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = header,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0.5, -19),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
            Text = "×",
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 24,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 304,
        })
        closeButton:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
        corner(closeButton, 11)

        local dragStrip = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = header,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Active = true,
            ZIndex = 305,
        })

        local chipBar = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
            Parent = ShaderCustomWindow,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 30),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 82),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollBarThickness = 0,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
            ZIndex = 303,
        })
        mk("UIListLayout", {
            Parent = chipBar,
            FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
        })

        local scroll = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
            Parent = ShaderCustomWindow,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -124),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 118),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollBarThickness = 3,
            ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
            Active = true,
            ScrollingEnabled = true,
            ZIndex = 302,
        })
        scroll:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")

        local scrollPadding = mk("UIPadding", {
            Parent = scroll,
            PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2),
            PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4),
            PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4),
            PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 18),
        })
        local scrollLayout = mk("UIListLayout", {
            Parent = scroll,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 10),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        })

        local closeWindow
        closeWindow = function()
            shaderDisconnectAll()
            ShaderCustomControls = {}
            if ShaderCustomWindow then ShaderCustomWindow:Destroy() end
            if ShaderCustomBackdrop then ShaderCustomBackdrop:Destroy() end
            ShaderCustomWindow = nil
            ShaderCustomBackdrop = nil
            ShaderCustomRefresh = function() end
        end

        closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.45)
            closeWindow()
        end)

        local dragging = false
        local dragStart = nil
        local windowStart = nil
        dragStrip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                windowStart = ShaderCustomWindow.Position
            end
        end)
        shaderAddConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                ShaderCustomWindow.Position = UDim2.new(
                    windowStart.X.Scale, windowStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    windowStart.Y.Scale, windowStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end))
        shaderAddConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end))

        local specs = shaderCustomSpecs()
        local currentSection = nil
        for _, spec in ipairs(specs) do
            if spec.section then
                currentSection = shaderCreateSection(scroll, spec.section[1], spec.section[2], spec.section[3], spec.section[4])
            elseif currentSection then
                if spec.toggle then
                    shaderCreateToggle(currentSection, spec)
                else
                    shaderCreateSlider(currentSection, spec)
                end
            end
        end

        local footer = shaderCreateSection(scroll, "Acciones", "Actions", "Los controles se aplican en tiempo real.", "Controls apply in real time.")
        local restore = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = footer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
            Text = GetText("Restaurar valores originales", "Restore original values"),
            TextColor3 = Theme.AccentText,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 12,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 314,
        })
        restore:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        restore:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Restaurar valores originales")
        restore:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Restore original values")
        corner(restore, 10)
        restore.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.45)
            ShaderDemoEnabled = false
            local report = shaderRestoreAll()
            shaderWarn(report, "Restauración personalizada")
            shaderSetModeLabel("Original")
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
        end)

        for order, entry in ipairs(ShaderUISections) do
            entry.updateCount()
            local chip = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = chipBar,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
                Text = GetText(entry.es, entry.en),
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 11,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                LayoutOrder = order,
                ZIndex = 304,
            })
            chip:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            chip:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            chip:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            corner(chip, 999)
            stroke(chip, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
            mk("UIPadding", {Parent = chip, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 30), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)})
            RowKit.IconAt(chip, entry.icon, 14, UDim2.new(0, -21, 0.5, -7), 305, "Accent")
            chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
                entry.setOpen(true)
                task.defer(function()
                    if not scroll.Parent then return end
                    local y = entry.frame.AbsolutePosition.Y - scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y + scroll.CanvasPosition.Y - 4
                    TweenService:Create(scroll, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, y))}):Play()
                end)
            end)
        end

        ShaderCustomRefresh = function()
            for _, control in pairs(ShaderCustomControls) do
                if control.refresh then pcall(control.refresh) end
            end
        end
        ShaderCustomRefresh()
        shaderAddConnection(ShaderCustomWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
            task.defer(ShaderCustomRefresh)
        end))
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait()
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
        end)
        Window._refreshShaderCustomTheme()
    end

    Window._refreshShaderCustomTheme = function()
        if not ShaderCustomWindow or not ShaderCustomWindow.Parent then return end
        swapThemeColor(ShaderCustomWindow, Theme)
        for _, obj in ipairs(ShaderCustomWindow:GetDescendants()) do
            swapThemeColor(obj, Theme)
        end
        if ShaderCustomBackdrop then
            ShaderCustomBackdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        end
    end

    ShaderSavedState = shaderLoadPersistence()
    if ShaderSavedState then
        if type(ShaderSavedState.demoEnabled) == "boolean" then ShaderDemoEnabled = ShaderSavedState.demoEnabled end
        if type(ShaderSavedState.preset) == "string" then
            local savedPreset = ShaderSavedState.preset
            if savedPreset == "BlackSilhouette" then savedPreset = "depthstyle" end
            if ShaderManager.Presets[savedPreset] then
                ShaderDemoPreset = savedPreset
            end
        end
        if type(ShaderSavedState.quality) == "string" and ShaderQualityProfiles[ShaderSavedState.quality] then
            ShaderSceneQuality = ShaderSavedState.quality
        end
    end

    local initialDemoReport
    -- Optimización > "Shaders apagados": no se aplica nada al iniciar
    if ShaderDemoEnabled and not PerfOpt.Flags.NoShaders then
        initialDemoReport = shaderApplyPreset(ShaderDemoPreset, false)
    else
        initialDemoReport = shaderRestoreAll()
    end
    shaderWarn(initialDemoReport, "Demo inicial")

    if ShaderSavedState and not PerfOpt.Flags.NoShaders then
        local restoreCustomOverrides = ShaderSavedState.customMode == true
        if restoreCustomOverrides and type(ShaderSavedState.custom) == "table" then
            ShaderCustomOverrides = ShaderSavedState.custom
            for _, spec in ipairs(shaderCustomSpecs()) do
                if spec.id then
                    local value = ShaderCustomOverrides[spec.id]
                    if type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                        if type(spec.onChange) == "function" then
                            pcall(spec.onChange, value)
                        else
                            shaderApplySingle(spec.target, spec.property, value)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local overdrive = ShaderSavedState.overdrive
        if type(overdrive) == "table" then
            if type(overdrive.reflectionIntensity) == "number" then ShaderReflections:SetIntensity(overdrive.reflectionIntensity) end
            if type(overdrive.wetness) == "number" then ShaderReflections:SetWetness(overdrive.wetness) end
            if type(overdrive.surfaceMode) == "string" then ShaderReflections:SetSurfaceMode(overdrive.surfaceMode) end
            if type(overdrive.sceneCoverage) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetSceneCoverage(overdrive.sceneCoverage) end
            if type(overdrive.skyMirror) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetSkyMirrorEnabled(overdrive.skyMirror) end
            if type(overdrive.stripTextures) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetStripTexturesEnabled(overdrive.stripTextures) end
            if type(overdrive.objectMirror) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetObjectMirrorEnabled(overdrive.objectMirror) end
            if type(overdrive.contactStrength) == "number" then ShaderReflections:SetContactStrength(overdrive.contactStrength) end
            if type(overdrive.modelDetail) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetModelDetailEnabled(overdrive.modelDetail) end
            if type(overdrive.characterSpecular) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetCharacterSpecularEnabled(overdrive.characterSpecular) end
            if type(overdrive.excludeLocalAvatar) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetExcludeLocalAvatar(overdrive.excludeLocalAvatar) end
            if type(overdrive.modelShadows) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetShadowEnabled(overdrive.modelShadows) end
            if type(overdrive.shadowStrength) == "number" then ShaderReflections:SetShadowStrength(overdrive.shadowStrength) end
            if type(overdrive.sunHue) == "number" then ShaderSolarTone.Hue = math.clamp(overdrive.sunHue, 0, 1) end
            if type(overdrive.sunSaturation) == "number" then ShaderSolarTone.Saturation = math.clamp(overdrive.sunSaturation, 0, 1) end
            if type(overdrive.sunStrength) == "number" then ShaderSolarTone.Strength = math.clamp(overdrive.sunStrength, 0, 1) end
            if type(overdrive.sunHue) == "number" or type(overdrive.sunSaturation) == "number" or type(overdrive.sunStrength) == "number" then ShaderSolarTone:Apply() end
            if type(overdrive.wetReflections) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetEnabled(overdrive.wetReflections) end
            if type(overdrive.contact) == "boolean" then ShaderReflections:SetContactEnabled(overdrive.contact) end
            if type(overdrive.rainIntensity) == "number" then ShaderRain:SetIntensity(overdrive.rainIntensity) end
            if type(overdrive.rainAudio) == "boolean" then ShaderRain:SetSoundEnabled(overdrive.rainAudio) end
            if type(overdrive.rainAudioVolume) == "number" then ShaderRain:SetSoundVolume(overdrive.rainAudioVolume) end
            if type(overdrive.rainShelter) == "boolean" then ShaderRain:SetRespectShelter(overdrive.rainShelter) end
            if type(overdrive.rain) == "boolean" then ShaderRain:SetEnabled(overdrive.rain) end
            if type(overdrive.storm) == "boolean" then ShaderRain:SetStormEnabled(overdrive.storm) end
        end
    end

    local AutoTabShaders = Window:CreateTab("Shaders", "Shaders", "rbxassetid://132270533063321")
    local ShaderHero = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = AutoTabShaders.Page,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 138),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        ZIndex = 9,
    })
    corner(ShaderHero, 16)
    mk("UIGradient", {
        Parent = ShaderHero,
        Rotation = 90,
        Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 46)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Color3.fromRGB(92, 52, 140)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 146, 92)),
        }),
    })
    local heroSun = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = ShaderHero,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 62),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.82, 0, 0.78, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 140),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 10,
    })
    corner(heroSun, 999)
    mk("UIStroke", {Parent = heroSun, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120), Thickness = 8, Transparency = 0.75})
    for _, p in ipairs({{0.08, 0.18}, {0.2, 0.32}, {0.36, 0.12}, {0.52, 0.26}, {0.66, 0.1}, {0.9, 0.2}, {0.44, 0.4}}) do
        local star = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = ShaderHero, Name = "HeroStar", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), Position = UDim2.new(p[1], 0, p[2], 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        corner(star, 999)
    end
    local heroHill = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = ShaderHero,
        Size = UDim2.new(1.4, 0, 0, 60),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, -22),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 22),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 11,
    })
    corner(heroHill, 999)
    -- Imagen real de portada (assets/shaders/Hero.jpg): reemplaza el dibujo de sol, estrellas y colina.
    -- Un degradé oscuro a la izquierda deja leer el título y el texto.
    Window._ShaderArt.get("Hero", function(img)
        if not ShaderHero.Parent then return end
        heroSun.Visible = false
        heroHill.Visible = false
        for _, ch in ipairs(ShaderHero:GetChildren()) do
            if ch.Name == "HeroStar" then ch.Visible = false end
        end
        mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = ShaderHero, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = img, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        local sombra = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = ShaderHero, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11,
        })
        mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = sombra,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.75),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
        })
    end)
    local heroTitle = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = ShaderHero,
        Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 32),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 12),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "Shaders",
        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        TextSize = 28,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 12,
    })
    heroTitle:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
    local heroSub = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = ShaderHero,
        Size = UDim2.new(0.66, 0, 0, 44),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 46),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = GetText(
            "Elegí un modo visual o abrí Personalizado para ajustar cada parámetro sin tocar los sliders del resto de la librería.",
            "Choose a visual mode or open Custom to tune every parameter without touching the library's other sliders."),
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 222, 240),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextSize = 11,
        TextWrapped = true,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
        ZIndex = 12,
    })
    heroSub:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
    heroSub:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Elegí un modo visual o abrí Personalizado para ajustar cada parámetro sin tocar los sliders del resto de la librería.")
    heroSub:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Choose a visual mode or open Custom to tune every parameter without touching the library's other sliders.")

    ShaderModeLabel = AutoTabShaders:CreateLabel("Modo activo: Morning", "Active mode: Morning", 11)
    ShaderModeLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")
    ShaderModeLabel.Parent = ShaderHero
    ShaderModeLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    ShaderModeLabel.TextWrapped = false
    ShaderModeLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
    ShaderModeLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -32)
    ShaderModeLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    ShaderModeLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    ShaderModeLabel.ZIndex = 13
    corner(ShaderModeLabel, 999)
    mk("UIPadding", {Parent = ShaderModeLabel, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)})

    AutoTabShaders:CreateButton("Restablecer todo por defecto", "Reset everything to default", function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.55)
        ShaderDemoEnabled = false
        local report = shaderRestoreAll()
        ShaderReflections.OilSheen = false
        ShaderReflections:SetObjectMirrorEnabled(false)
        ShaderReflections:SetStripTexturesEnabled(false)
        ShaderReflections:SetSkyMirrorEnabled(false)
        ShaderReflections:SetContactEnabled(false)
        ShaderReflections:SetShadowEnabled(false)
        ShaderReflections:SetCharacterSpecularEnabled(false)
        shaderWarn(report, "Restablecer todo")
        shaderSetModeLabel("Original")
        ShaderCustomRefresh()
        shaderQueuePersistence()
    end)

    AutoTabShaders:CreateDivider()
    AutoTabShaders:CreateLabel("Modos visuales", "Visual modes", 13)
    AutoTabShaders:CreateLabel(
        "Cada tarjeta muestra el cielo, la hora y la luz del modo · tocá para aplicarlo.",
        "Each card shows the mode's sky, time and light · tap to apply it.",
        10
    )
    local ShaderModeGrid = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = AutoTabShaders.Page,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 9,
    })
    mk("UIGridLayout", {
        Parent = ShaderModeGrid,
        CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 0, 156),
        CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
    })
    mk("UIPadding", {Parent = ShaderModeGrid, PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)})

    shaderCreateModeCard(ShaderModeGrid, {
        key = "Custom",
        labelES = "Personalizado",
        labelEN = "Custom",
        descES = "Ajustá cada shader en tiempo real",
        descEN = "Tune every shader in real time",
        callback = function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.55)
            ShaderDemoEnabled = true
            shaderSetModeLabel("Custom")
            shaderOpenCustomWindow()
        end,
    })

    local shaderPresetButtons = {
        {"Mañana", "Morning", "Morning", "Luz suave y cálida para comenzar"},
        {"Mediodía", "Midday", "Midday", "Claridad alta y sombras definidas"},
        {"Atardecer", "Sunset", "Sunset", "Tonos dorados con contraste cinematográfico"},
        {"Noche", "Night", "Night", "Azules profundos y ambiente nocturno"},
        {"Lluvia", "Rain", "Rain", "Niebla fría y cielo cubierto"},
        {"Tormenta", "Stormfront", "Stormfront", "Lluvia local, reflejos húmedos y relámpagos dinámicos", "Local rain, wet reflections and dynamic lightning"},
        {"Cinemático", "Cinematic", "Cinematic", "Profundidad de campo y look de película"},
        {"Sol Especular", "Golden Specular", "GoldenSpecular", "Hora dorada, reflejos cálidos en superficies y modelos", "Golden hour, warm highlights on surfaces and models"},
        {"Aceite Mojado", "Oil Wet", "OilWet", "Suelo y paredes espejo, bloom intenso y look aceitoso", "Mirror floors and walls, intense bloom and oily look"},
        {"Glow Vibrante", "Vibrant Glow", "VibrantGlow", "Pasteles saturados · bloom intenso y atmósfera etérea", "Saturated pastels · intense bloom and ethereal atmosphere"},
        {"Retro", "Retro", "Retro", "Gradación clásica y color vintage"},
        {"depthstyle", "depthstyle", "depthstyle", "Personajes y escenario negros con cielo y atmósfera blancos", "Black characters and scene with white sky and atmosphere"},
        {"Ultra Realista", "Photoreal", "Photoreal", "Luz natural, sombras nítidas y pisos con brillo sutil", "Natural light, crisp shadows and subtly glossy floors"},
        {"Hora Azul", "Blue Hour", "BlueHour", "Crepúsculo azul y violeta con bloom suave", "Blue and violet dusk with soft bloom"},
        {"Niebla", "Fog", "Foggy", "Mañana con neblina espesa y colores apagados", "Thick misty morning with muted colors"},
        {"Desierto", "Desert", "Desert", "Sol fuerte, calima dorada y cielo despejado", "Harsh sun, golden haze and clear sky"},
        {"Ciudad Neón", "Neon City", "NeonNight", "Noche magenta y cian con piso espejo realista", "Magenta and cyan night with realistic mirror floor"},
        {"Diluvio", "Monsoon", "Monsoon", "Lluvia torrencial, cielo negro y rayos constantes", "Torrential rain, black sky and frequent lightning"},
        {"Nivel 0", "Level 0", "Level0", "Cinta perdida: luz amarilla, grano, lente abierto y algo que no está bien", "Lost tape: yellow light, grain, wide lens and something not quite right"},
    }
    for _, presetData in ipairs(shaderPresetButtons) do
        local data = presetData
        shaderCreateModeCard(ShaderModeGrid, {
            key = data[3],
            labelES = data[1],
            labelEN = data[2],
            descES = data[4],
            descEN = data[5] or (data[2] .. " atmosphere"),
            callback = function()
                ShaderDemoPreset = data[3]
                ShaderDemoEnabled = true
                shaderSetModeLabel(data[3])
                shaderApplyPreset(data[3], true)
            end,
        })
    end

    shaderCreateModeCard(ShaderModeGrid, {
        key = "Original",
        labelES = "Restaurar original",
        labelEN = "Restore original",
        descES = "Volver a la iluminación guardada del juego",
        descEN = "Return to the game's saved lighting",
        callback = function()
            ShaderDemoEnabled = false
            local report = shaderRestoreAll()
            shaderWarn(report, "Restauración")
            shaderSetModeLabel("Original")
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
        end,
    })
    shaderSetModeLabel("Morning")

    AutoTabShaders:CreateDivider()
    AutoTabShaders:CreateLabel("Overdrive local", "Local overdrive", 13)
    AutoTabShaders:CreateLabel(
        "Lluvia realista, superficies húmedas y presupuesto adaptable. Todo se restaura al desactivar el modo.",
        "Realistic rain, wet surfaces and adaptable budget. Everything restores when the mode is disabled.",
        10
    )
    do
        -- Grupos compactos de 2 columnas (antes: 11 filas grandes seguidas)
        local function overdriveGroup(icon, titleES, titleEN, items)
            local group = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = AutoTabShaders.Page,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 9,
            })
            group:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(group, 14)
            stroke(group, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
            mk("UIPadding", {Parent = group, PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)})
            mk("UIListLayout", {Parent = group, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})

            local head = mk("Frame", {Parent = group, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 0, ZIndex = 10})
            local headIcon = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = head, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
                BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11,
            })
            headIcon:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            corner(headIcon, 9)
            RowKit.Icon(headIcon, icon, 15, 12, "Accent")
            local headTitle = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = head, Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText(titleES, titleEN), TextColor3 = Theme.Accent, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 13,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
            })
            headTitle:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")
            headTitle:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", titleES)
            headTitle:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", titleEN)
            local counter = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = head, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                Text = "", TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, ZIndex = 11,
            })
            counter:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            counter:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
            counter:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            corner(counter, 999)
            mk("UIPadding", {Parent = counter, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9)})

            local grid = mk("Frame", {Parent = group, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 10})
            mk("UIGridLayout", {Parent = grid, CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 58), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})

            local states = {}
            local function refreshCounter()
                local on = 0
                for _, v in ipairs(states) do if v.get() then on = on + 1 end end
                counter.Text = GetText(on .. "/" .. #states .. " activos", on .. "/" .. #states .. " on")
                counter.TextColor3 = on > 0 and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.TextDim
                counter:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", on > 0 and "ToggleOn" or "TextDim")
            end

            for order, item in ipairs(items) do
                local state = item.get() == true
                local tile = mk("Frame", {Parent = grid, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 10})
                tile:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
                corner(tile, 12)
                local tileStroke = stroke(tile, Theme.Stroke, 1.2, 0.6)
                local tileScale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = tile, Scale = 1})
                local tileIcon = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = tile, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), Position = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0.5, -15), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11,
                })
                corner(tileIcon, 9)
                RowKit.Icon(tileIcon, item.icon, 16, 12, "Text")
                local tileName = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = tile, Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, -12), Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 6), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = GetText(item.es, item.en), TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 11,
                    TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
                })
                tileName:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
                tileName:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", item.es)
                tileName:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", item.en)
                local sw = mk("Frame", {Parent = tile, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 18), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -9, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11})
                corner(sw, 999)
                local knob = mk("Frame", {Parent = sw, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12})
                corner(knob, 999)
                local click = mk("TextButton", {Parent = tile, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 13})

                local function paint(animate)
                    local info = TweenInfo.new(animate and 0.2 or 0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                    TweenService:Create(sw, info, {BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(knob, info, {Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(tileIcon, info, {BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff, BackgroundTransparency = state and 0.55 or 0.4}):Play()
                    sw:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
                    tileIcon:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
                    tileStroke.Color = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.Stroke
                    tileStroke.Transparency = state and 0.15 or 0.6
                    tileStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "Stroke")
                end
                click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.45)
                    state = not state
                    tileScale.Scale = 0.95
                    TweenService:Create(tileScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
                    p
